name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for window repair in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for window repair in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for window repair in Daly City, prioritize experience with your specific window type and material. Look for contractors who are licensed, insured, and have positive local references or reviews. Ask about their diagnostic process and how they provide estimates—detailed, written quotes are crucial. Ensure they offer a warranty on both parts and labor. A good contractor will clearly explain the problem, the proposed solution, and the cost, and they should be familiar with common Bay Area home construction and climate considerations that affect windows.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for licensed, insured contractors with good local reviews, specific window experience, clear diagnostic processes, written estimates, and warranties on parts and labor in Daly City.
